title: Research: exact L253 temporal gauge over the 218-helper k8 word
body:
## Status

Finite scalar construction; no new κ and no selected-supplier change.

On the PR1094 complex word, the frozen simultaneous constant-gauge candidate in [PR1263](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1263) costs 136,002 / 136,018 complex primitives. This package adds one time-varying gauge on L253 and reduces the complete words to **135,820 / 135,836**, saving another **182 complex primitives per orientation**. The total scalar saving against the original 149,002 / 149,018 word is 13,182 per orientation. Paid recursive profiles are unchanged; selected κ remains 0.001672660197076918.

## Scope and exact method

OS seed 27 assigns the complex-supplier track. The object was selected as index `27 mod 218` in PR1263's sorted forward gauge support: helper L253. The other 217 gauges stay fixed. For each orientation, all 96 incident ADDs are optimized by an exact sequence DP over every integer schedule. The proven finite exponent domains are [-2,4] forward and [-4,2] backward; each DP checks 4,662 state transitions and attains a -91 real-primitive delta. All transition scales and changed coefficients are charged. The resulting schedules add 21 scale macros in each orientation.

The verifier replays the complete word over all 712 formal data, helper and center columns in both orientations; checks source/frame/paid-event identity, complete scalar invoices, paid-profile equality and the local 192-bit payload limit; and authenticates the selected certificate. An independent DP agrees. Controls include exhaustive comparison on a three-use fixture, the zero-schedule no-op, and rejection after omitting an inserted transition scale.

## Overlap and attribution

Sagar Thakrar's [PR1259](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1259) studies a temporal gauge on L276 over the original word. This result uses seed-selected L253 over PR1263's 218-helper constant-gauge word. Concurrent [PR1310](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1310) studies two-coordinate constant gauges around PR1263 and explicitly leaves phase-varying composition open. This PR adds that distinct temporal schedule class and does not combine PR1310's candidate.

Exact base: `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. PR1263, PR1259 and all vendored inputs are pinned in the package. The local sprint claim, three-candidate triage, source inventory, certificate and validation record are included. No pinned sprint coordination issue was available.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/k8-varying-many-gauge-seed27
```

Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/k8-varying-many-gauge-seed27 outcome=completed`.

Passed on CPython 3.12.15 (registered replay) and 3.14.7 (optimized direct replay). No native supplier/hosted admission, selected cold frontier replay, global multi-coordinate optimum, new κ, or full multiplication theorem is claimed. Inherited compiler/all-size, realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic and bit-interface assumptions remain.

Prepared by Cinna Davis / @1337isnot1337 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing; no independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0. Credit Philipp / @mightyOil (PR1263), Sagar Thakrar (PR1259/PR696), @woklerx (PR1161), Hanson Sun / @bbMisk (PR1214), the PR1310 authors, and the retained PR1094 supplier lineage.
